menuItems.name: Velvet Honey Cortado
menuItems.subtitle: Double Ristretto · Wildflower Honey · Oat Microfoam
menuItems.description: Pulled at 9 bars from our washed Pink Bourbon micro-lot, balanced with velvety house-steamed barista oat milk and raw Sierra wildflower honey.

menuItems.name: First-Harvest Uji Matcha
menuItems.subtitle: Stone-Milled Tencha · Bamboo Whisked · Hot or Iced
menuItems.description: Single-cultivar Samidori tencha hand-picked in May and slow-milled on granite wheels. Whisked to order with 78°C spring water for zero bitterness.

menuItems.name: Sparkling Yuzu Espresso Tonic
menuItems.subtitle: Ethiopian Single Origin · Botanical Tonic · Fresh Yuzu
menuItems.description: Chilled heirloom espresso floated gently over crisp artisanal quinine tonic, cold-pressed Kochi yuzu juice, and a dehydrated blood orange crown.

menuItems.name: Alishan High Mountain Oolong
menuItems.subtitle: Gongfu Steeped · Whole Rolled Leaves · 3 Infusions
menuItems.description: Lightly oxidized mountain oolong harvested above the mist line. Brewed in matte clay kyusu for aromatic floral lift and a lingering nectar sweetness.

menuItems.name: Saffron & Green Cardamom Chai
menuItems.subtitle: Assam Second Flush · Crushed Whole Spices · Saffron
menuItems.description: Slow-simmered for 90 minutes each morning using freshly mortared green cardamom, Ceylon cinnamon, black peppercorn, and bold malty Assam leaf.

menuItems.name: Origin Flight V60 Pour-Over
menuItems.subtitle: Precision Bloomed · Single Micro-Lot · Rotating Weekly
menuItems.description: Honey-processed Caturra roasted 48 hours prior in our Probat drum roaster. Brewed with remineralized water at 93°C for tea-like crystalline clarity.

faqs.question: How does the Reach & Earn program actually work?
faqs.answer: Once you join the free Ritual Club, you receive a personal tasting invite link and QR pass. Every time you order a coffee, ceremonial tea, or bag of beans, you earn Golden Beans (500 Beans = any free craft drink). When a friend claims their free welcome drink through your link, you immediately receive 250–500 Golden Beans plus up to $10 in instant store credit depending on your tier—with zero cap on earnings.

faqs.question: Can I enjoy both specialty coffee and ceremonial tea under one membership?
faqs.answer: Yes! Unlike traditional coffee-only subscriptions, every pass credit and Bean reward applies equally across our entire espresso bar, single-origin V60 pour-overs, granite-milled Uji ceremonial matcha, Taiwanese Gongfu oolongs, and seasonal spice infusions.

faqs.question: How fresh are your coffee beans and tea harvests?
faqs.answer: We roast our direct-trade micro-lots in small batches every Monday and Thursday morning—every pour-over and bag sold is rested between 48 hours and 10 days for peak aromatics. Our ceremonial matcha is air-freighted chilled directly from Uji family farms and stored nitrogen-sealed at 4°C until whisked.

faqs.question: Do unused Ritual Pass drinks or Golden Beans expire?
faqs.answer: Golden Beans never expire as long as you visit or redeem once within 12 months. Unused monthly Ritual Pass drink credits automatically roll over for 30 days, or you can gift an unused pour directly to a friend with one tap to earn bonus community Beans.

faqs.question: Are plant-based milks and decaf / low-caffeine options available?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. We craft house-made organic cashew-oat milk alongside Minor Figures oat and cold-pressed almond milk. For low- or zero-caffeine afternoons, we offer Swiss Water Process Colombian decaf espresso, roasted Kyoto hojicha, and caffeine-free mountain botanicals.

faqs.question: Can I pause or cancel my paid Ritual Club plan anytime?
faqs.answer: Yes—zero lock-in contracts or hidden fees. You can pause for travel, switch tiers, or downgrade back to the free Daily Sipper plan in two clicks from your member profile, keeping all your earned Golden Beans intact.
